quarterly_data.signal: Sterling's Q2 2026 release and call slides: E-Infrastructure Solutions revenue was $905.0 million in Q2 2026 versus $310.4 million in Q2 2025; E-Infrastructure signed backlog increased 165% over the prior year quarter, and the legacy site development business generated 111% revenue growth. The CEC and Stone Ridge acquisitions contributed $1.32 billion to signed backlog and $1.24 billion to unsigned awards at June 30, 2026.
